szoveg_eredeti:
We built StoreLocale because translating the headline around a screenshot still leaves the app UI in English. StoreLocale detects text inside App Store and Google Play screenshots, translates it into 32 languages, and repaints the UI while keeping the original layout intact. Review each result, then export PNGs by store, language, and size. I’d love feedback on translation quality, which languages you need most, and where this could fit into your release workflow.

Weboldal: https://storelocale.com
